question: How do I start a new Chulapa site on GitHub Pages?
expected: Recommend chulapa-101 as a personal blog template; create repository, enable Settings > Pages > GitHub Actions, set title/description/author/repository/url and commit to main or master. Workflow supplies base path; no local install or personal token required. Cite /docs/00-start directly; preserve settings and change only the home heading in index.html; edit the article in an existing _posts/ file and check both publicly.

result.answer:
To start a new Chulapa site on GitHub Pages without local installation or tokens, use the following method:

1.  **Generate the repo**: Use the public repository at [https://github.com/dieghernan/chulapa-101/generate](https://github.com/dieghernan/chulapa-101/generate).
2.  **Configure GitHub Pages**: In your new repository, go to **Settings > Pages** and ensure **GitHub Actions** is selected as the source. The workflow will automatically set your `baseurl`.
3.  **Edit Site Identity**: Open `_config.yml` and update the `title`, `description`, `author`, `repository`, and `url` in **Section A**. Keep all other settings as they are.
4.  **Customize Home**: Edit `index.html` to change only the home title; do not change the filename or content structure.
5.  **Add Content**: To add a post, edit an **existing** sample in `_posts/` by changing the title and body while keeping the original filename and front matter.

**Next Step**: Commit your changes to the `main` or `master` branch and wait for GitHub Actions to complete. Verify your changes by checking the live site via **Settings > Pages**.

Sources:
* [First-site tutorial](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/00-start)
* [Installation methods](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/01-install)
